summary: The change adds percentage coupons to the cart and a page() helper to the catalog, with tests for both.

finding.title: Each page is one product short
finding.explanation: page() slices to start + size - 1, so every page holds size - 1 products instead of size.

finding.title: apply_coupon crashes on an unknown coupon code
finding.explanation: CouponBook.find() returns None for an unknown code, but apply_coupon reads coupon.percent without checking, so an unknown code raises AttributeError instead of being ignored as the docstring says.

entries.label: wrong: the guard is the two lines before

finding.title: Cart.add stores a sku without checking the product exists
finding.explanation: catalog.find(sku) can return None for an unknown sku, and add() goes on to store the sku in self.lines without a None check, so a later subtotal would fail.

entries.label: wrong: the test plainly asserts the behaviour

finding.title: test_coupon_discount never checks the discount
finding.explanation: The test applies a coupon but asserts nothing about the resulting total, so it passes even if the coupon has no effect.
finding.evidence:
assert cart.apply_coupon("save10") is True
assert cart.total_cents() == 360
